subject: Finlytics POC: success criteria & week1 status
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Finlytics POC: proposal, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we’re all aligned before kickoff: 

Summary of needs (from our discovery):
- Sub-second average latency for 95th percentile queries on 2k token prompts
- Batch embedding throughput for nightly ingestion (approx 10M rows over 2 weeks)
- Audit logs and retention policy for compliance (SOC2 requirement)
- Integration with existing S3 data lake and BI dashboards

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks):
1) Week 0 (setup): access, sample dataset ingest, RBAC + audit config.
2) Week 1: run production-like latency tests and validate embeddings pipeline at target throughput.
3) Week 2: quality checks against your evaluation set and dashboarding for cost/latency.

Success criteria (what Finlytics should verify):
- Latency: p95 <= 400ms on 2k prompts (measured over a 24h window)
- Throughput: embeddings pipeline sustains 250k rows/hour with <2% error rate
- Integration: ability to read/write to your S3 bucket and surface results in Looker
- Security: Audit logs exported to your SIEM and 90-day retention configured

Owners / roles:
- Redwood: Marissa (project lead) + Rishi (SRE / infra) + Sean (solutions engineering)
- Finlytics: Alex (POC owner) + Priya (data eng)

Next steps:
- I attached a mutual action plan (Finlytics-POC-MAP.xlsx) and a draft SLA for review.
- Can you confirm S3 credentials and the evaluation dataset location by EOD Tuesday (2026-10-06)?
- I’ll schedule a 30m kickoff for Wed 2026-10-07; Rishi will provision a sandbox cluster.

Attachments: Finlytics-POC-MAP.xlsx, Redwood-SLA-Draft.pdf

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Quick week 1 status:
- Priya shared the dataset and S3 path (s3://finlytics-poc/samples) — ingest looks consistent but need a small schema tweak (one null-int column).
- We ran an initial embedding job; throughput was ~180k rows/hour. We’ll try to parallelize more from our side but want to understand Redwood’s recommended instance sizing.
- Two asks from Priya: 1) can audit logs be forwarded to Splunk via S3? 2) what’s the retention granularity (daily/weekly) we can configure?

Blocking: we don’t have the temp creds for the sandbox yet (Rishi?). That’s preventing a full run of the latency harness.

Thanks — overall progressing, but hoping to unblock the creds so we can hit the Week 1 latency tests.

— Alex
